parse.title: Quests
parse.text:

Quests is an openable Interface that can be used to review the Player's unfinished Quests.

Every day, you can earn up to 3,000 Gems3,000 Gems from daily quests! This is one of the easiest and fastest ways to get gems so far. Key word being easiest there are other ways to get gems that are hard, but this method is the easiest if you do not own a macro software.

Information

Quests are separated into 4 different Categories. Event, Daily, Infinite, and Story quests.

  • Daily quests are quests that are granted every 24 hours. These quests are randomized for everyone and give Gems as a reward for completing them. Completing all daily quests will earn you Battle pass XP and Event Tokens. Daily quests reset after 24 hours. After Update 16 - Overlord Update, it gives 900 pearls as Event Tokens.
  • Event quests are quests that are granted during an Event.
  • Story quests are the Player's World quests. These can be completed from time to time as you progress further through the Story. Each Act will earn you 80 Gems80 Gems + 50 Level XP if it's a first time clear, otherwise you'll earn 20 Gems20 Gems and 50 Level XP for clear.
  • Infinite quests are the players random daily Infinite quests. they are a re-vamp of the daily infinite mode rewards and were added in update 7.00. These quests are randomized for 3 maps and give Gems as a reward for completing them. They reset after 24 hours.
